cohort: Women who gave birth in 1998-1999 or 2010-2011 (n=12,098)
finding: Maternal age, BMI, and EA administration were significantly associated with CS rates in women classified as RTGCS group 1, while only maternal age and BMI were significantly associated with CS rates in women classified as RTGCS group 3.
mod_finding: Epidural analgesia administration was found to be significantly and independently associated with an increased rate of cesarean section in nulliparous women with a single cephalic pregnancy at term, in spontaneous labor.
